scope: Trusted first-install controller and native account journal; no AppKit or production integration

configuration.helpers: Exact absolute executable path plus sha256; no PATH lookup
configuration.testFactory: testing.mjs, test-only native compile macro SEP_INSTALLER_ENTRY_TESTING

methods.preview: Read-only native account snapshot plus candidate verification; returns pass/preview with exact plan and planHash
methods.cancel: Only {planHash}; invalidate in-memory preview, no journal/parent/target/data changes
methods.confirm: Only {planHash}; exact current preview, native recheck, durable upper confirmation, durable bound core plan, execute
methods.resume: Only {transactionId}; known own fixed journal, confirmation/core/state integrity, explicit recovery only
methods.close: Close admission and wait accepted work/native closure; timeout or unknown returns blocked, never termination

upperPlan.candidate: source identity, inventory hash, PROGRAM and BOOTSTRAP hashes
upperPlan.account: uid, native home path and dev:ino
upperPlan.paths: Fixed target, dataRoot, governanceRoot and Applications existence/identity
upperPlan.actions: Explicit creation of missing fixed directories only
upperPlan.hash: sha256 of canonical JSON plan with planHash omitted

records.confirmation.json: Upper plan and approval; durable before core plan
records.mode: private directory 0700, regular single-link record 0600; reject aliases and nonempty ACLs in owned governance
records.native: openat/fstatat/no-follow fd-bound reads and atomic writes; file fsync+F_FULLFSYNC, directory fsync; persistent exclusive lease

recovery.planned: Explicit resume may begin the already-approved bound core plan
recovery.executing: Use core recover; missing/unverifiable core journal is blocked
recovery.publishedWithData: Verify published identity and complete records; never remove data or repeat app start
recovery.committed: Reverify target and return receipt; no reinstallation
recovery.unknown: Preserve records, target and data; no reset or automatic migration
